tools.name: show_info
tools.description: When ATC is live, who hosts it, the regular panel, how to come on the show, and archive coverage.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search every ATC show for a topic, project, person or claim. Returns matching show segments (id, title, url). Use fetch with an id for the summary and a transcript excerpt.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read a show segment (id from search: summary plus a transcript excerpt) or an episode (Space id or YYYY-MM-DD date: summary, chapters and segment ids to fetch).

tools.name: search_segments
tools.description: Find the moments in ATC shows where a subject was discussed, ranked by relevance, with date, timestamp, speakers, summary and link. Filter by date range or speaker.

tools.name: search_transcripts
tools.description: Exact-word search across every ATC transcript line. Returns quotes with speaker, X handle, timestamp, surrounding lines and episode link. Best for 'who said X' and quotes.

tools.name: list_episodes
tools.description: List ATC shows, newest first, optionally filtered by date range, tag (e.g. 'btc', 'stablecoins', 'nfts') or speaker.

tools.name: get_episode
tools.description: One ATC show by date (YYYY-MM-DD) or Space id: summary, speakers, tags, timestamped chapters and links.

tools.name: topic_timeline
tools.description: How a subject came up on ATC over time: every matching segment in date order (oldest first) with what was said, who said it and links. Good for 'how has the show's view on X changed'.

tools.name: speaker_profile
tools.description: An ATC speaker by name or X handle: appearances, first and last show, what they talk about most, and their recent segments.

tools.name: speaker_calls
tools.description: A speaker's on-air ATC calls and their record (calls, hits, misses, not scored), newest first, each with quote, date, asset, direction, level, result and share link. Results come from the ATC leaderboard.

tools.name: asset_calls
tools.description: Who called an asset on ATC, when, which direction and the result (from the ATC leaderboard), newest first.

tools.name: calls_leaderboard
tools.description: ATC calls leaderboard, same rule as atcspaces.com: speakers with at least 20 scored calls (hit or miss) ranked by hit rate, ties broken by total hits. Everyone else is listed separately as not enough scored calls yet.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, search_transcripts · Private data: speaker_calls · Public sink: speaker_calls.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, search_transcripts · Private data: speaker_calls · Public sink: speaker_calls

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
